info.description: Postman + Newman tests for the DummyJSON e-commerce API: auth (JWT login, current user, refresh) and products. Built from `context/test-case-matrix.md`; each request's description names its Case ID and rule. Run with `scripts/run-newman.sh main|data|defects`. Credentials are passed at run time and never stored here.

item.description: The 13 defects the companion pytest suite pins as strict xfails. Each request asserts what the API should do. Run with `scripts/run-newman.sh defects`; CI runs it without failing the build.
